messages:
maya: FYI Acme reports "structured_output" failures after auth token expiry. saw a few 400 parse errors and a couple 500s on retries. ticket #9872: https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-9872
jon: repro steps from customer?
maya: they call our text generation endpoint with structured JSON mode (structured_output: true). flow: client gets 401 from expired token, refreshes token, retries the same request. sometimes the API returns a parse error on the streamed response. attached logs show partial JSON then a fallback plaintext chunk.
riley: can you paste the exact request/response?
maya: here — curl they used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <EXPIRED_TOKEN>\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{"model":"xlarge-v2","structured_output":true,"prompt":"invoice -> {id:int,amount:float,status:enum[PAID,UNPAID]}\nData:"}'
```
then after refresh they retry with new token and we see this in our edge logs:
```
[2024-11-05T14:12:09Z] request_id=req_abc123 status=401 auth=expired
[2024-11-05T14:12:10Z] request_id=req_abc123 status=200 auth=ok downstream_stream_id=stream_42
[2024-11-05T14:12:11Z] stream=stream_42 partial_chunk='{"id":12345,"amount":"99.9","Status":"PAID'
[2024-11-05T14:12:11Z] stream=stream_42 error=truncated_stream
```
alex: interesting — note the partial chunk: amount is quoted (string) and Status key is capitalized. schema expects numeric id, float amount, enum lowercase values. that explains type mismatch and enum-case drift. but why does auth flow affect streaming?
sam: my guess: when the token expired we did a short-circuit response and then the client re-used the same stream id or we resumed a stream incorrectly. need to check our retry/resume logic in the auth middleware.
jon: can we reproduce locally? riley, can you run a local pipeline simulating expired token -> retry-> resumed stream?
riley: on it. i'll run a quick local with the same model and structured_output flag. will script the retry sequence.
maya: customer says this happens ~1-2% of requests when token refresh latency > 250ms. they saw downstream billing spikes because the client retried and produced duplicate tokens billed as separate calls.
alex: billing angle: customer was charged twice for the same logical request? need finance cc.
jon: action items:
- riley: repro and attach minimal repro script + logs (ETA 2h)
- alex: open billing review for ACME-9872 and flag potential duplicate charges (ETA EOD)
- sam: audit auth middleware stream resume codepath for token expiry (ETA 24h)
- maya: keep customer updated and request sample failing output (ETA asap)

riley: quick repro notes: i can reproduce truncated streamed chunk if i close the initial connection mid-stream before resume. looks like the resumed stream concatenates chunks without boundary checks, causing malformed JSON (numbers sometimes arrive as strings depending on chunk boundaries).
jon: that implies our stream assembler needs stronger framing — we should not assume tokens align with JSON tokens. also lowercase/uppercase enum issue: some model output variants are capitalizing enum values in certain prompts. need normalization step in structured_output parser (case-insensitive enum matching).
sam: filing a bug: INF-5643 — resume-framing: stream chunk boundary handling on auth retry. linking logs.
maya: customer asked for workaround: can we recommend client-side idempotency or set shorter token lifetime?
alex: suggest client use idempotency-key header so retries don't double-bill, and server should treat replays with same idempotency-key as one request. also recommend retry-after header handling.
maya: i'll send ACME a quick mitigation note now: idempotency-key + increase token refresh parallelism.
jon: long term fixes: 1) server-side stream-framing fix 2) enum normalization in parser 3) ensure billing dedupe when replayed request_id or idempotency-key present.
support-bot: Ticket updated: INF-5643 created, linked to ACME-9872. Assigned: sam, riley. Priority: P1 for customer-impact on billing.
maya: thanks. i'll update the customer thread and mark this for escalation if repro confirmed.
alex: tagging @finance to watch ACME billing review. :eyes:
maya: any quick logs i should attach to ticket? riley: attach the stream chunks above and request_id mapping. also include edge proxy logs between 14:12:08-14:12:12.
jon: good. keep thread here with updates.
